title: Stepanov gives a FIXED-r theorem the Weil/AG route cannot (Betti wall): push the vanishing order, not the moment depth
evidence: Exact F_p linear algebra (Hasse-derivative confluent Vandermonde, rank over F_p) at prize-regime PROPER dyadic mu_n (n=2^mu | p-1, p~n^4, n<<sqrt p): n=8/p=4129, n=16/p=65537, n=32/p=1048609, n=64/p=16777601; plus shallower n^2.3 controls (n=16/p=769, n=32/p=3137). For order M, d_min(M) := min degree of a nonzero polynomial vanishing to order >=M at every point of the degenerate set A = mu_n cap (c+mu_n); Stepanov then gives r(c) <= d_min(M)/M. CORE RESULT (scripts/probes/_407_conn/_C062_order3_out.txt, _C062_v2_out.txt): d_min(M) = M*|A| EXACTLY for every M=1..8, with discount (M*|A| - d_min) = 0 at every order, even for the LARGEST degenerate set A=mu_n (c=0). So r(c) <= d_min(M)/M = |A| = trivial bound for ALL M -- the order-M confluent ladder yields ZERO improvement over order 2. The hoped-for family deg Psi = O(n + M^2) (which would give r<=O(n^{2/3})) DOES NOT EXIST; minimal degree is M*|A|, slope |A|, no structural discount. This matches the route map's own StepanovGenericInsufficiency.generic_stepanov_degree_ge (t*M <= B forces B/M >= t). CONTROL (_C062_control_out.txt): for EVERY genuine off-diagonal c (c^n != 1) at every regime, the degenerate set has |A| = 2 maximally; the explicit order-2 Q=(c-X)^{n+1}+X^{n+1}-c vanishes to order EXACTLY 2 (machine-checked Hasse_2(Q) != 0 on A) and NEVER beats generic (d_min(M)=2M, Q's degree n+1 is far worse than the true minimal degree 2). The additive energy E(mu_n) is concentrated entirely on c=0 (only c with r(c)>=3); off c=0 the subgroup is Sidon-like (all r(c)<=2), so the order-3 confluent target set with |A|>=3 does not even exist off the diagonal.
honest_note: Two true things survive and are not in dispute: (1) repCount_two_mul_le_of_pow_ne_one (r(c) <= (n+1)/2) is a genuine char-p, Betti/conductor-free in-tree axiom-clean theorem -- the connection's framing that Stepanov fixes r and pushes M (Betti-free, unlike the AG/GLT route capped at r=2) is correct as a meta-observation. (2) What is REFUTED is the specific ACTIONABLE claim of the attack_plan: that a confluent order-M auxiliary with deg=O(n+M^2) exists and yields r<=O(n^{2/3}), E_p<=O(n^{8/3}). The probe shows the minimal order-M auxiliary degree is exactly M*|A| (generic, no degeneracy discount), so the ladder collapses to the order-2 base case with no asymptotic gain. Caveat: the order-2 bound (n+1)/2 is itself enormously loose in the prize regime (true off-diagonal r(c)=2 << (n+1)/2), confirming the real arithmetic content lives at c=0 where A=mu_n is the full subgroup via the trivial -1 symmetry, not a two-relation collapse -- and there too the discount is exactly 0. The Hasse-derivative rank computation is exact integer arithmetic over F_p (Gaussian elimination, modular inverses), reproducible. Scope: tested n up to 64 with M up to 8; the d_min(M)=M*|A| identity is uniform and matches the abstract dimension count, so extrapolation to n=2^30 is safe. This welds back to the additive-energy / BGK wall (W-LamLeung): the energy E(mu_n) is fixed by c=0, and Stepanov cannot reduce its degree budget below generic. Belongs in DISPROOF_LOG (order-M confluent Stepanov ladder = generic dimension count in disguise).
wall: W-LamLeung (additive-energy / BGK sqrt-cancellation): the confluent Stepanov ladder is the generic dimension count (d_min(M)=M*|A|) and cannot beat r(c)<=|A|; the energy budget at c=0 (A=mu_n) admits no vanishing-order discount.
